review_policy: All proposals start Proposed. A reviewer must record approve/reject/defer, evidence version, rationale and date in a reviewed change before implementation. Browser shortlists are local preferences, not shared approval or execution.

suggestions.title: Resolve data-use rights before a betting product
suggestions.proposal: Obtain explicit permission or a licensed data agreement for the intended collection, publication and wagering use. Keep NFL-derived prices disabled until then.
suggestions.known: NFL.com §1.3 restricts systematic retrieval/commercial use; §12 prohibits using Services to wager on NFL games.
suggestions.unknown: Whether a separate license exists; applicable club terms; intended jurisdiction and distribution.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents a polished product from depending on unauthorized data use.
suggestions.tradeoff: Licensing cost and lead time; no shortcut around missing permission.
suggestions.acceptance: Written scope covers sources, derived prices, storage, redistribution and intended use; reviewer records approval.

suggestions.title: Seal an as-of evidence ledger
suggestions.proposal: Store immutable source versions, retrieval timestamps, publication timestamps when supplied, stable player/game IDs and feature availability times.
suggestions.known: Current pages are mutable; this handoff is a dated normalized transcription, not a historical archive.
suggestions.unknown: Authorized historical injury/depth/inactive and market snapshots; source-publication timestamps.
suggestions.benefit: Makes leakage auditable and prevents retrospective information from masquerading as a pregame signal.
suggestions.tradeoff: Storage and licensing overhead; older missing history cannot be reconstructed honestly.
suggestions.acceptance: Every forecast references an immutable input hash and all feature timestamps precede its seal.

suggestions.title: Separate injury, lineup and replacement evidence
suggestions.proposal: Adopt the supplied printed-depth join, but require a club starter announcement or official game participation record before naming an actual replacement.
suggestions.known: 276 injury rows and 289 printed club slots are available in this bounded snapshot; injuries are not depth ranks.
suggestions.unknown: Final inactives, actual starters, snap shares and replacement-specific performance effects.
suggestions.benefit: Avoids treating every DNP as an absent starter or every second-string player as a confirmed replacement.
suggestions.tradeoff: More unresolved rows and explicit abstentions; no fabricated deficiency score.
suggestions.acceptance: Starter, replacement, availability and performance-impact fields each carry independent evidence and timestamps.

suggestions.title: Archive executable market offers
suggestions.proposal: Use an authorized operator/data source for opening and closing spreads, totals, moneylines and player props, including limits, fees and settlement terms.
suggestions.known: No authorized timestamped offer panel is present; fair-price math alone cannot establish ROI or CLV.
suggestions.unknown: Licensed feed, operator/jurisdiction coverage, SGP pricing and void/push rules.
suggestions.benefit: Enables a real market baseline and executable economics rather than hindsight comparisons.
suggestions.tradeoff: Cost, rights and operational complexity; paper-only until validated.
suggestions.acceptance: Offer IDs, timestamps, prices, limits and settlement versions join to forecasts without missingness.

suggestions.title: Build a coherent scoring-distribution model
suggestions.proposal: Start with opponent-adjusted offense/defense scoring rates and uncertainty; compare discrete scoring distributions with half-point normal approximations.
suggestions.known: The engine can transform explicit probability inputs into fair research prices; it cannot create missing team-strength estimates.
suggestions.unknown: Verified historical game panel, possession definitions, overtime treatment, weather and venue covariates.
suggestions.benefit: Produces internally consistent spread/total/moneyline research rather than unrelated picked numbers.
suggestions.tradeoff: Model risk and calibration burden; normal tails and zero integer-push mass can be wrong.
suggestions.acceptance: Chronological calibration and proper-score tests beat frozen baselines; integer lines use a push-capable model.

suggestions.title: Estimate joint outcomes, not just pairwise correlation
suggestions.proposal: For each combo family, collect aligned settled legs and actual joint outcomes; report hit-event phi, joint rates and game-block uncertainty.
suggestions.known: No verified NFL bet-leg correlation panel is present. Pairwise correlations do not determine three-plus-leg joint probabilities.
suggestions.unknown: Threshold-specific outcomes, SGP contracts, void handling and enough independent games.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents false parlay value from multiplying assumed-independent probabilities.
suggestions.tradeoff: Data volume and sparse-cell uncertainty; some combos must remain unpriceable.
suggestions.acceptance: Joint model is checked on untouched games and against exact operator settlement; no universal correlation constant.

suggestions.title: Preregister one untouched confirmation window
suggestions.proposal: Freeze hypotheses, preprocessing, offer universe, exclusions, power target, scoring and stopping rules before collecting future results.
suggestions.known: Retrospective tuning and selective reporting can manufacture apparent skill; Holm adjusts a defined family but cannot recover unlogged experiments.
suggestions.unknown: Power under realistic dependence, complete attempt registry and future data access.
suggestions.benefit: Separates a repeatable research claim from the best of many lucky backtests.
suggestions.tradeoff: Long wait and failed candidates; no guarantee of an eligible winner.
suggestions.acceptance: Sealed protocol/hash exists before the window; every attempt and abstention is logged; final test is not retuned.

suggestions.title: Rank evidence, not hot streaks
suggestions.proposal: Run separate single/parlay/prop-combo divisions on identical windows and offers; rank only all-gate qualifiers by conservative lower-return bound.
suggestions.known: The supplied leaderboard function rejects missing evidence and mismatched cohorts; the real leaderboard is empty.
suggestions.unknown: Qualified forward records and any funded/approved reward program.
suggestions.benefit: Makes strategies comparable and discourages cherry-picked ROI screenshots.
suggestions.tradeoff: No exciting winner until sufficient evidence exists; merit points are not money.
suggestions.acceptance: Common cohort hashes, complete gate artifacts, deterministic ranking and zero cash claims.

suggestions.title: Add a reviewer decision queue
suggestions.proposal: Use this Suggestions page to compare benefit, tradeoff, missing evidence and acceptance tests; export a shortlist for a versioned review change.
suggestions.known: A static site cannot safely record shared approval without a backend and identity/audit controls.
suggestions.unknown: Reviewer identity, governance, budget and implementation ownership.
suggestions.benefit: Keeps discovery and implementation separate and makes the next decision inspectable.
suggestions.tradeoff: Local shortlists are not authoritative approval; a reviewed repository change is still required.
suggestions.acceptance: No proposal changes production behavior until its decision record and implementation are separately reviewed.

suggestions.title: Publish coverage and abstention beside every metric
suggestions.proposal: Show source scope, missingness, sample size, uncertainty and no-go reason in the same view as each finding.
suggestions.known: Blank game status is not 'available'; club depth charts may be unofficial; no luck-removal claim is justified.
suggestions.unknown: Future source coverage and operator-specific completeness.
suggestions.benefit: Improves decisions by making uncertainty visible instead of hiding it in footnotes.
suggestions.tradeoff: More verbose UI and fewer apparently actionable rows.
suggestions.acceptance: Every table row has an official source link; unknown values remain blank and carry a review reason.

questions.question: May the intended system collect, redistribute and use NFL/club data for betting?
questions.known: Published NFL terms restrict systematic retrieval and commercial use and prohibit using Services to wager on NFL games.
questions.answer: Not established. Do not enable NFL-derived betting prices or wagering from these sources.
questions.missing: Explicit license/permission and legal review for the actual use and jurisdiction.
questions.discovery: Request written scope from rights holders; record grant, restrictions and expiry before implementation.
questions.decision_gate: Blocks commercial/live release, not this informational audit.

questions.question: Which operator, jurisdiction, market universe and settlement rules are intended?
questions.known: No operator or jurisdiction was specified in the request; no current offer contract is verified here.
questions.missing: Operator names, applicable jurisdiction, market/period definitions, OT, DNP, void/push and fee rules.
questions.discovery: Read official operator terms for a reviewed candidate list; keep applicability blank until confirmed.

questions.question: What historical offers were actually available at each forecast time?
questions.known: The snapshot contains injuries/depth, not a licensed odds history.
questions.missing: Opening/closing prices, limits, timestamps, offer IDs and SGP prices.
questions.discovery: Procure authorized history; join by game/market/time and verify against operator records.

questions.question: Can a useful independent line be calculated from the information on hand?
questions.known: Pricing primitives are implemented and tested on synthetic inputs; injury counts are not team-strength probabilities.
questions.answer: Mathematically yes with explicit probabilities; an actual verified NFL line is not available from this snapshot.
questions.missing: Authorized game-level scoring/possession panel, fitted distributions, uncertainty and market baseline.
questions.discovery: Build the P05 panel and chronological model; publish no line before rights and validation gates pass.

questions.question: Who is a starter, who is a backup, and who actually replaced an absent starter?
questions.known: Club charts print positional order; some are explicitly unofficial. Injury designations describe participation/availability, not rank.
questions.answer: Use separate fields. A chart plus Out can flag exposure, but cannot alone confirm the actual replacement or its performance deficit.
questions.missing: Timestamped club charts, starter announcements, final inactives and participation/snap records.
questions.discovery: Collect immutable versions and join by stable player/team/game IDs; preserve shared listings and gaps.

questions.question: Does a blank injury or game-status cell mean healthy/available?
questions.known: NFL distinguishes practice participation from game status; a player certain to play may have no game-status designation.
questions.answer: No. Preserve the blank and do not infer a clean bill of health or final active status.
questions.missing: Final game active/inactive list and any later update.
questions.discovery: Collect official game-day inactives and timestamped updates; reconcile rather than overwrite earlier reports.
questions.decision_gate: Blocks certainty claims from incomplete reports.

questions.question: How large is the quality drop from a starter to the second/third/fourth option?
questions.known: Printed depth order does not quantify ability, fit or expected snap share.
questions.missing: Verified replacement identity, snaps, role, opponent context and enough comparable outcomes.
questions.discovery: Estimate uncertainty-aware role/performance changes only after actual participation is known; avoid a universal backup penalty.

questions.question: What are the actual correlations among proposed bet legs?
questions.known: No aligned settled NFL prop/offer panel exists here; the correlation fields are intentionally blank.
questions.missing: Exact thresholds, per-game aligned legs, joint settlement and operator combo rules.
questions.discovery: Use P06; calculate hit-event phi/joint rates with game-block intervals and disclose sparse coverage.

questions.question: Are parlay legs independent?
questions.known: Shared game scripts, players, opponents, slate conditions and model errors can create dependence.
questions.answer: Do not assume independence. Different games are not automatically independent either.
questions.missing: Joint outcome history and exact payout/void contract.
questions.discovery: Compare observed joint rates with a product benchmark; model the full joint distribution for 3+ legs.

questions.question: Can luck be removed?
questions.known: Random outcomes remain random; selection, small samples and repeated testing can create attractive backtests.
questions.answer: No. Reduce avoidable bias and quantify uncertainty; do not claim luck-free or guaranteed skill.
questions.missing: Prospective sealed forecasts, complete experiment registry, adequate power and market-relative performance.
questions.discovery: Run P07/P08 with chronological splits, proper scores, multiplicity correction and date-block uncertainty.

questions.question: How much data is enough to qualify a strategy?
questions.known: Project policy requires 500 selections, 200 games, 60 dates and a 60-day/200-game shadow record; these are not official skill standards.
questions.answer: Those are minimum admission floors only. A dependence-aware power/precision analysis can require more.
questions.missing: Effect size, variance, clustering, attrition and number of attempted variants.
questions.discovery: Simulate power under realistic dependence before sealing the test; publish the calculation.

questions.question: Which strategies deserve a reward today?
questions.known: No strategy has verified all-gate evidence, market economics or a prospective record.
questions.answer: None. The leaderboard is empty and no cash prize is funded or promised.
questions.missing: Qualified entries in a common future cohort; separately approved reward governance if money is ever considered.
questions.discovery: Admit only verified strategies; award non-transferable merit points under the frozen rules.

questions.question: How will source changes and conflicting reports be handled?
questions.known: Mutable pages can change; a third-party injury aggregator disagreed with the official league table during research and was not used.
questions.answer: Keep versioned evidence, flag published-vs-published conflicts and abstain on unresolved identity/status fields.
questions.missing: Authorized immutable historical snapshots and stable IDs.
questions.discovery: Use bounded source capture after rights review; compare rendered content and preserve discrepancies.
questions.decision_gate: Blocks silent overwrites and stale-status signals.

questions.question: What is the next best implementation path?
questions.known: Rights, as-of data and market history are prerequisites; depth/injury evidence is necessary but insufficient for an edge.
questions.answer: Review P01/P02/P04 first, then P03/P05/P06, then seal P07/P08. This is a recommendation, not an approved implementation decision.
questions.missing: Reviewer choices, resources and evidence grants.
questions.discovery: Export a shortlist and record a versioned approve/defer/reject decision with rationale; implement only approved scope.
